isodep_apdu.h and isodep_wtx.h are copied unmodified from John McLear's
ST25R3916 ESPHome component (esphome_st25r_yondoor/components/st25r/),
doorplan commit 9a4003b7781c86944071279488461527e2173a95 (2026-09-10,
"ISO-DEP block chaining, so the transport can carry an Aliro transaction").
That component is MIT licensed.

They have no ESPHome dependency; the esphome::st25r namespace is historical.
Do not edit them here. Fix upstream and copy again, so the two stay
byte-identical and the host tests keep meaning the same thing in both places.

SHA-256 at copy time:

a010ed625155756dcc6a547b9d64330c06f2ad10fb45b9db6bf715a701f28baf  isodep_wtx.h

Their 23 host tests are copied, also unmodified, to
